description: This file defines internal data structures related to streaming consumers in the Orleans project, including enum for consumer state and a class representing consumer data with serialization attributes and cursor disposal logic.

classes.name: StreamConsumerData
classes.description: A class representing metadata and state for a stream consumer, including subscription ID, stream ID, consumer extension, state, cursor, last token, filter data, and a disposal method for the cursor.

methods.name: StreamConsumerData
methods.description: Constructor initializing stream consumer data with subscription ID, stream ID, consumer extension, and filter data.

methods.name: SafeDisposeCursor
methods.description: Safely disposes of the cursor, catching and logging any exceptions thrown during disposal.
